name: Directory Of Toilets In Public Parks
description:
This dataset is a directory of public park toilets, with 616 sampled rows and six columns. Each record identifies a facility by name and location, and notes whether it is open year-round, whether it is handicap accessible, and which borough it is in. A comments field captures occasional notes, such as facilities that are currently closed or that keep limited hours during the school day. Coverage spans five boroughs, with Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, and the Bronx accounting for most entries and Staten Island making up a small share. Most facilities are listed as open year-round, and the accessibility field is sparsely populated, with every recorded value marked as accessible.

The data supports practical uses such as building park visitor maps, creating accessibility and restroom-finding guides, and comparing how public toilet facilities are distributed across boroughs. It can also help identify seasonal or temporary closures and inform municipal planning and maintenance decisions.
